translations.en:
The fact that labyrinth
scorpions survive without
being attacked by other
monsters suggests that they
carry deadly poison. Their
unusually developed exoskeletons
also easily deflect light
blows. The red stinger at
the tip of the tail is
called the trigger of a
dying scream. Its victims
are feared to suffer
unbearable agony before death.

translations.en:
A swarm of flying insects so
vast that even trying to count
them would be exhausting.
Each insect attacks as if it
had a will of its own. However
many times a sword strikes,
it crushes only a few bugs
and does little harm to the
swarm as a whole. Sometimes
the insects surge forward
like a breath attack,
something virtually
impossible to defend against.

translations.en:
At first glance it resembles
a stuffed rabbit and
behaves adorably, but it
is very much a monstrous
animal. Many subspecies
exist, all sharing sharp
teeth that can easily
penetrate steel armor.
They also possess the
horrifying habit of
severing human heads.

translations.en:
A crab whose body measures
more than three meters.
Its shell is hard enough
to chip a sword's point.
Its huge pincers do
not cut cleanly so
much as crush victims
painfully into two
pieces. Its vitality
is also extraordinary;
even after its limbs
are torn off, it
often remains alive.

translations.en:
Several times larger than a human,
it can kill even a heavily armored
knight once its coils close
around them. Flimsy armor is
easily crushed. Even if stronger
armor withstands the pressure,
the victim is injected with
poison. Nevertheless, an adventurer
who stays calm will find it
less formidable than a demon.

translations.en:
At just under two meters long, it is
not much larger than a human. Its
scythes are sharper than one might
imagine, however, and can sever an
unwary victim's head with a single blow.

Being an insect, it also
has a hard exoskeleton and
can fly nimbly even through
narrow labyrinths. Females
eat the males, which
keeps their numbers low.

translations.en:
Its most distinctive feature is
its seemingly limitless size.
It soars leisurely near the
stratosphere, then suddenly
plummets with enough force to
split the sky, seizes an elephant
in its claws, and rises again.

The terror of a monstrous bird
with a wingspan exceeding a
hundred meters crawling through
a labyrinth is beyond measure.

translations.en:
Though its swollen body
appears bloated with fat,
more than half of that
bulk is actually gas,
which it mercilessly
exhales at adventurers.

This fast-acting poison has a
low fatality rate, but is more
than effective enough at
draining its victims' strength.

translations.en:
A breath-using dragon
subspecies. It feeds on other
monsters and can be considered
the top of the food chain
among lesser animal and
plant monsters. Apart from
its breath, it is weaker
than it looks. Calmly watch
its flight path and strike,
and it should be easily
defeated. Territorial disputes
between it and Gas Dragons
are often observed.

translations.en:
Considered a dragon subspecies,
though some claim it is merely
a huge flying lizard. Those
supporting the lizard theory
point out that it cannot use the
breath attacks characteristic
of dragons. It firmly grips prey
with hooked claws and inflicts
fatal wounds. Its tail also
bears a sharp stinger harder
than its claws, apparently
allowing it to stab its victims.

translations.en:
As the name suggests, it
is an infant dragon,
probably a kind of White
Dragon. Though only about
the size of a Human
child, its breath is
powerful. It is also
faster than one would
expect, making it difficult
to land attacks on it.

translations.en:
Also known as the Nine
Dragons, or Kowloon. As that
name suggests, it is a golden
dragon with nine heads.

Its astonishing regenerative
power is said to allow
two new heads to grow
immediately wherever
one has been severed.

Their numbers are small, so
encounters with them are rare.
translations.note: Kowloon follows the explicitly supplied pronunciation of the Nine Dragons alias.

translations.en:
A famous dragon found
throughout the world,
representative of
dragonkind. It exhales
flames hot enough
to vaporize iron.

It lacks a hydra's regenerative
ability, and its hide is not
impenetrable to swords. However,
merely getting close to it is
so difficult that adventurers
should expect a hard battle.

translations.en:
Its golden scales and noble
bearing give this dragon
an almost divine aura.
Highly intelligent, it
can converse with humans.

Even if adventurers oppose
it and somehow defeat it,
it draws limitless vitality
from the ground and
revives. To destroy it
completely, it must be
dragged into water.

translations.en:
Beautiful black scales like gemstones,
and a blue mane that glimmers faintly.

Ordinarily indifferent to
human affairs, it nevertheless
sometimes waits for
adventurers in the labyrinth
with some purpose in mind.

translations.en:
Wielding the lowest level
of black magic, these women
prey on the valuables of
adventurers who appear
inexperienced. Negotiation
is possible, but they too
are desperate to survive,
so agreements are rarely
reached. Adventurers unable
to defeat even them should
not venture any farther.

translations.en:
Once they aspired to become
glorious adventurers, but
they lost their way and now
attack other adventurers to
rob them of their valuables.

However, they lack sufficient
experience and their equipment
is unimpressive, so they
should be easily defeated.

translations.en:
A female Priest is
called a Priestess.

Some attack adventurers for
the heretical gods they
worship. Others were
excommunicated for breaking
religious rules... Each has
a purpose of her own. These
deeply devout women wield
low-level white magic and
strike with force comparable
to front-row fighters.

translations.en:
Like priestesses, these
Priests challenge adventurers
for various reasons. Religious
rules forbid them to carry
bladed weapons, so they
attack with blunt weapons
such as maces. Wearing
breastplates and other armor
to improve their defenses,
they confound adventurers
with low-level Priest spells.

translations.en:
Like witches, most
Mages encountered
in labyrinths are
enemies of adventurers,
wielding low-level
attack magic.

However, as Mages, they lack
stamina and wear no armor
capable of withstanding direct
attacks. They pose little
threat to adventurers with a
reasonable amount of training.

translations.en:
The Rogues found in labyrinths
lack a Fighter's strength
and stamina, cannot use
heavy equipment, and know
little of magic. Instead,
they simply lay traps
and wait for adventurers
to fall into them.

They deliberately place monsters
in an adventurer's path, then
attack from behind once the
victim is exhausted by battle.

translations.en:
Having learned even a little
of the Ninja's art, they
can sever an unwary
adventurer's head in a single
blow. Their extraordinary
speed easily evades a clumsy
warrior's sword, and they
strike faster than a Mage
can finish chanting.

They excel at fighting in
groups, using coordinated
attacks to wipe out adventurers.

translations.en:
A swordsman whose rigorous spiritual
training allows the use of black magic.

From their state of mind to
their sense of beauty, Samurai
possess a distinctive outlook.
Each serves a single lord and
considers dying beautifully
a virtue. However, some have
been completely consumed by
evil and lost all sense of
self. Be cautious when meeting
Samurai in the labyrinth.

translations.en:
Do not assume an easy
victory merely because
they wear no armor.

They excel at controlling their
odic energy. Though nearly
half-naked, they protect themselves
with an invisible defense of
that energy, making them tougher
than lesser warriors. A single
blow from a weapon cloaked in
odic energy is said to shatter
the labyrinth's stone paving.

translations.en:
Bishops of the Quopati
Legal Academy, servants of
a god... Even they sometimes
succumb to greed and stray
from the path. Though they
do not use every spell at
their disposal, they
remain troublesome enemies.
If a high-ranking Bishop
becomes an enemy, focus
first and foremost on
sealing their magic.

translations.en:
As capable as a Lord, this
warrior annihilates adventurers
with a Fighter's swordsmanship
and high defense while
wielding advanced healing
spells. Unafraid to lay
down their life for their
god's will, they rise
again however badly
wounded. Anyone who
encounters one should prepare
for a prolonged battle.

translations.en:
A Dark Crusader has fallen
entirely into darkness and
attacks anyone without
mercy. Perhaps betrayed by
something they once believed
in, or exploited by a demon
through a weakness in
their heart... Having lost
all human reason, they
are beyond negotiation.

translations.en:
The stealth arts originated in
the distant east. Once apparently
passed down only among certain
races, they have since spread
in altered forms throughout the
world. In close combat, Ninja
techniques can sever an adventurer's
head with bare hands. Their
speed leaves afterimages,
allowing them to evade sword
strikes and spells with ease.
A Ninja is an extremely dangerous
and troublesome opponent.
